retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast surrealist scene featuring a burning luxury yacht under a vibrant aurora borealis on a tropical beach with scattered debris.

recipe.visualDefinition: A digital composition blending a tropical beach foreground with a catastrophic maritime event, illuminated by a celestial light phenomenon in a deep purple and blue night sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the cold aurora and the hot fire of the yacht
Juxtaposition of a peaceful sleeping/unconscious figure and a violent disaster
Vertical palm tree framing the left against the horizontal horizon line
Scattered foreground objects leading the eye toward the central burning subject
coreInvariants: Vibrant purple and cyan aurora borealis
Burning modern yacht with thick black smoke
Sandy beach foreground with scattered debris
Deep blue night sky with visible stars

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The burning yacht is mid-ground right, balanced by a large palm tree on the far left and a figure in the lower left foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange flames and black smoke of the yacht serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the aurora's vertical streaks down to the yacht, then sweeps across the foreground debris to the figure on the sand.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant of the sky provides open space to balance the dense detail of the beach and ship.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep violet and midnight blue sky
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright cyan and emerald green aurora streaks
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky and fire against the desaturated, neutral tones of the sand and rocks.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high luminosity in the aurora

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme tracking for a cinematic feel.
graphicDevices: Small star/eye icon in the top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric structure that matches the modern aesthetic.
Classic geometric sans that handles wide tracking well.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal night scene on a tropical beach. In the mid-ground, a modern luxury yacht is engulfed in flames with thick black smoke. The sky is a deep purple filled with stars and a vibrant cyan and green aurora borealis. In the foreground, a man in a suit and fedora lies face down on the sand next to an acoustic guitar, empty bottles, and scattered life jackets. A palm tree with a monkey stands on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a bold geometric sans-serif font at the bottom center. Use all uppercase letters with very wide tracking and a subtle drop shadow to ensure readability against the sand.

verificationChecks: Is the aurora vibrant and multi-colored?
Is the yacht visibly on fire with realistic smoke?
Is the typography widely spaced and centered at the bottom?
Are the foreground elements (guitar, bottles, figure) clearly defined?

adjustableVariables: Amount of smoke from the yacht
Density of debris on the beach
mustRedesign: Avoid generic beach lighting; must be night-time surrealism
Ensure the text does not touch the edges of the frame

mustAchieve: High-contrast lighting between fire and night sky
avoid: Muted or dull colors in the sky

postGenerationChecks: Check for color harmony between the purple sky and orange fire
Verify the scale of the palm tree relative to the yacht
Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally
Confirm the presence of the aurora streaks
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a catastrophic event with a celestial phenomenon using a high-saturation palette and wide-tracked geometric typography for a surreal cinematic look.
